subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que possam ser representados por equações polinomiais de 1º grau, redutíveis à forma ax + b = c, fazendo uso das propriedades da igualdade.

components.description_pt: Escrever uma equação ou expressão para representar uma situação de problema real
components.description_en: Write an equation or expression to represent a real-world problem situation
components.cc_component_description: Write an equation or expression to represent a real-world problem situation

components.description_pt: Resolver equações das formas px + q = r e p(x + q) = r com fluência
components.description_en: Solve equations of the forms px + q = r and p(x + q) = r fluently
components.cc_component_description: Solve equations of the forms px + q = r and p(x + q) = r fluently

components.description_pt: Construir uma situação de problema que possa ser modelada por equação de primeiro grau ax + b = c
components.description_en: Construct a problem situation that can be modeled by a first-degree equation ax + b = c
components.cc_component_description: Construct a function, equation, or graph to represent relationships in a contextual problem

components.description_pt: Usar substituição para determinar se um número satisfaz uma equação
components.description_en: Use substitution to determine whether a number or a set of numbers makes an equation true
components.cc_component_description: Use substitution to determine whether a number or a set of numbers makes an equation true

cc_matches.description: Solve word problems leading to equations of the form px + q = r and p(x + q) = r, where p, q, and r are specific rational numbers. Solve equations of these forms fluently. Compare an algebraic solution to an arithmetic solution, identifying the sequence of the operations used in each approach. *For example, the perimeter of a rectangle is 54 cm. Its length is 6 cm. What is its width?*

Understand solving an equation or inequality as a process of answering a question: which values from a specified set, if any, make the equation or inequality true? Use substitution to determine whether a given number in a specified set makes an equation or inequality true.

prerequisites.description_pt: Compreender a ideia de variável, representada por letra ou símbolo, para expressar relação entre duas grandezas, diferenciando-a da ideia de incógnita.

unlocks.description_pt: Associar uma equação linear de 1º grau com duas incógnitas a uma reta no plano cartesiano.
